title: Drupal Patches Critical Core RCE Flaw with No-Login Path via Contributed Modules
description: Drupal core has a critical flaw in its Field UI module that could let an attacker run code on the site's server, and fixes were shipped on October 14 in Drupal

content.summary: Drupal core has a critical flaw in its Field UI module that could let an attacker run code on the site's server, and fixes were shipped on October 14 in Drupal 11.4.10, 11.3.19, and 10.6.19. An attacker cannot reach the flaw through core alone, the Drupal Security Team said in its advisory. Several exploit paths exist through contributed modules, and at least one known path needs no login....
content.impact: The implications of this cybersecurity update are significant for digital infrastructure in Tier-1 nations. Experts suggest that such developments could influence both consumer behavior and enterprise-level security protocols in the US, UK, CA, and AU markets.

keyPoints: Drupal core contained a critical flaw in its Field UI module. This flaw could allow an attacker to run code on the site's server. Fixes were released on October 14 in Drupal versions 11.4.10, 11.3.19, and 10.6.19.
